title: Constrained Partial Derivative Holding y Constant
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For w = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 subject to constraint z = x + y, find (dw/dx)_y.

steps.title: Eliminate Dependent Variable z
steps.explanation: Substitute z = x + y into w to express w solely in terms of independent variables x and y.
steps.why: Selecting (x, y) as independent coordinate basis.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to x Holding y Constant
steps.explanation: Compute partial derivative treating y as constant.
